relationship_edges.relation: USDC issuance, distribution, equity and revenue-sharing relationship
details: Circle's 2023 restructuring made Circle the sole USDC issuer/governance operator and gave Coinbase a minority equity stake plus commercial revenue-sharing.
Circle's 2025 S-1 reports Coinbase-held USDC at about 20% of circulation at 2024-12-31 and 25% at 2025-03-31, based on information provided by Coinbase.
The S-1 describes Coinbase's share of the remaining payment base after issuer retention and approved participants; platform-balance economics are distinct from broader distribution economics.
Circle's 2026 blog describes Coinbase as its largest/longest-standing partner and reports roughly $20B average USDC balances on Coinbase in Q2 2026, up 44% year over year.
caveats: Platform balance figures are issuer/partner-reported, not an independent wallet census.
Circle's aggregate distribution/transaction costs are not all paid to Coinbase.

relationship_edges.relation: USDC distribution and Arc validator relationship
details: SBI VC Trade was the first and only Japanese company Circle identifies as distributing USDC from March 2025.
SBI Group is in Arc's founding validator cohort announced September 16, 2026.
caveats: Arc is Circle's separate Layer-1 network, not XRPL.

relationship_edges.relation: Joint venture, historical investment, RLUSD distribution and XRPL proof of concept
details: SBI Holdings and Ripple jointly established SBI Ripple Asia in 2016; SBI announced additional investment in Ripple.
SBI VC Trade began RLUSD listing June 24, 2026.
SBI Ripple Asia's 2026 PoC uses XRPL for tokenized deposits and deposit-based digital money.
caveats: SBI VC Trade's initial VCTRADE RLUSD support was Ethereum-chain only.
XRPL use in a deposit PoC does not establish XRP token as collateral or settlement asset.

relationship_edges.relation: RLUSD listing, multichain access and Base liquidity
details: RLUSD became available on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail app on October 28, 2026.
Coinbase announced deposits/withdrawals across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base.
caveats: Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability was stated as a future follow-up, not live at launch.

caveats: Additional mint/redeem and tokenized trade-finance workflows are future/intended and subject to approvals.
